business_problem: FunPlus needed a better way to support player analytics, personalization, and game operations optimization because a complex warehouse environment spanning many operational systems made data access, ETL, and personalized insight delivery too manual and slow.
solution_summary: FunPlus uses Databricks Data + AI Platform to support player analytics, personalization, and game operations optimization. The implementation replaced a legacy state where a complex warehouse environment spanning many operational systems made data access, ETL, and personalized insight delivery too manual and slow. Game telemetry and player behavior move through Lakeflow Jobs and land in Delta Lake, giving teams one trusted data foundation. Unity Catalog governs access, lineage, and compliance across sensitive datasets. Databricks SQL, MLflow, and Genie operationalize models, agents, and analytics that deliver player insights and personalized recommendations.
business_outcome: FunPlus improved player analytics, personalization, and game operations optimization with measurable results including 40% optimizing online gaming with player personalization, 20% reduction in operational costs, and 48% improved efficiency, while giving teams a faster path from governed data to production decisions.
metrics: 40% optimizing online gaming with player personalization
